reasoning: 1. Filing party is the DRIVER, seeking restoration of the SGD 4.50 net no-show fee that support reversed (EV-TRIP-04059 fee_refunded event; EV-FARE-04059 payment_status REFUNDED, refund 6.61). Per POL-GEN-03 the question is whether the driver's claim that the fee was chargeable is supported; if not, NO_ACTION leaves the rider refunded. 2. POL-NS-01(a): arrived event present (18:21:00). (d): driver-terminated, RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding - satisfied in form. 3. POL-NS-02 / POL-NS-01(b): STANDARD zone, radius 50 m. Fixes 18:20:50 (27.1 m, acc 3.9), 18:21:00 (10.2 m), 18:21:10 (6.8 m) ... are 3+ consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes at/before the marker; arrival established. POL-NS-05: at the marker the driver was 10.2 m from the pin at 0 km/h - marker not false; no referral. POL-NS-03 not engaged: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the radius, not 50-400 m out. 4. POL-NS-01(c) dwell, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (EV-GPS-04059, haversine R=6371.0088): in-radius 18:20:50-18:21:50 (60 s); then 16 consecutive fixes 18:22:00-18:24:40 at 60.8-182.6 m (the 'one round'); back in-radius 18:24:50 until cancellation 18:26:05 (75 s). The continuous dwell required by POL-NS-01(c) is at most 75 s < 180 s, so limb (c) fails. 5. POL-NS-06(i): the driver left and re-entered within one pickup attempt, never more than 182.6 m from the pin (< 300 m), and EV-ADVIS-04059-01 is a populated KERB_RESTRICTION (bus lane) whose geometry passes 4.0 m from the pin and whose window 07:30-23:00 covers 18:21:00-18:26:05. Summing is therefore permitted: 60 + 75 = 135 s. Even bracketing each interval generously by the adjacent outside fixes (18:20:40-18:22:00 = 80 s; 18:24:40-18:26:05 = 85 s) gives 165 s. Under POL-NS-06(ii) the advisory never reduces the 180 s minimum nor excuses a shortfall; cumulative dwell falls short by 45 s (135 s basis), so the fee is not chargeable and the full refund to the rider stands with no driver compensation. The driver's '5 minutes' is the wall-clock 305 s from the marker, of which only 135 s was in the geofence. 6. POL-NS-07 not reached (POL-NS-01 not satisfied; anti-farming check moot: no_show_terminations_30d 1). POL-NS-04: rider message 'ok coming down now' (18:24:30) was answered by the driver at 18:24:55 (25 s) and the driver called at 18:23:20, so limb (b) fails; irrelevant to outcome anyway. POL-NS-10: driver cancelled, not rider; no waiting-time fee; limbs (a)-(g) not engaged. POL-NS-11: rider_track fixes in the window are all worse than 25 m accuracy, but rider presence decides nothing here. POL-NS-12: arrival_marker is BUTTON, not covered. 7. POL-NS-08: (a) arrival marker coincides with a GPS fix (0 s skew), termination 18:26:05 bracketed by fixes at 18:26:00/18:26:10; (b) max interval 10 s, 31 fixes in window; (c) 7 msgs sequential = chat_message_count, gap over marker 160 s < 5 min; (d) fare line 6.61 = rider_gross_cancellation_fee_sgd. No policy-level impairment. POL-NS-09: (c) counterparty disputes 0+0; (d) no anti-farming trip, rider no_show_disputes_30d 0; (b) no contradiction between artifacts; (e) n/a. No escalation. 8. POL-GEN-02: deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-04059 and EV-TRIP-04059 (weight 1.0) and EV-ADVIS-04059-01 (1.0); EV-DPROF-04059 is IMPAIRED (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.4, vehicle_type RYDE_XL vs RYDE_X) but carries no deciding fact; confidence cap 1.0. Result: the fee was not chargeable; the driver's claim is unsupported; per POL-GEN-03 the ruling is NO_ACTION (rider stays refunded), amount_sgd null, driver_compensation_sgd null, no referrals.
doubts: (1) Dwell measurement convention: interval endpoints could be taken from fix timestamps (135 s), from stationary-only fixes (40 + 65 = 105 s) or bracketed by adjacent outside fixes (165 s); all are below 180 s, so the outcome is robust. (2) One might argue the bus-lane advisory should let the driver's whole 305 s count; POL-NS-06(ii) expressly forbids that, and only in-geofence intervals sum. A reader who credited the out-of-radius loop time would reach DRIVER_COMPENSATION 3.60 (80% of 4.50 under POL-NS-07) - I consider that wrong under the text. (3) Some might label the outcome FULL_REFUND because POL-NS-06 licenses 'refunded to the rider in full'; but the filing party is the driver and the rider is already refunded, so POL-GEN-03's party-relative NO_ACTION is the correct label.
